'''Hoth (Japanese)''' is the Japanese-language edition of [[Hoth Limited]], released in September 1998. The set has 162 cards with black borders.<ref name="encyclopedia">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

== Packaging ==
The edition was sold in 15-card booster packs and 36-pack booster boxes.<ref name="encyclopedia" />
